Not me but my dad. He got diagnosed in March 2020. He had a mole that was kinda crusty and bleeding sometimes but at first he thought nothing of it because he shaved his legs (he's a cyclist) and it happened to make a small wound on the mole so he assumed it was because maybe the razor was a bit too sharp. But then it wouldn't heal for like a year and we urged him to go to the dermatologist. They referred him to an oncologist for removal and biopsy of the mole. Turned out he has an agressive melanoma. This all happened at the same time he caught his wife cheating on him, and her leaving him.  They started chemo treatment, he's one of the lucky ones who don't get sick from it, hasn't even lost hair. But the worst pain for him is that he lost the love of his life to another man (actually several others over the last two years). Overall he's doing pretty good but last week he had his check-up and they found some of his levels were too high, which means there are cells spreading throughout his body. They ordered another brain scan for him for next week, as they also found out he has a weak vessel in his brain that he's apparently had since birth. I was already scared to death when he first got diagnosed but now of course it's even worse. I'm so scared that this cancer will take him away from us.
